{{Top}}
A '''maneuver vane''',<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> '''control vane''',<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> or '''steering vane'''<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref> was a component found on [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]<ref name="GG9" /> [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]],<ref name="Ringers" /> and some [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as the [[Delaya-class courier|''Delaya''-class courier]].<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> There were usually at least two mounted on the vehicle.<ref name="GG9" />
